App.Title: Wayfinder
App.Subtitle: Guided PF2E creation and level-up
App.NoPending: No Wayfinder-guided steps are pending. PF2E-native or manual choices may still live on the character sheet.
App.FeedbackAria: Feedback — report a problem or suggest an idea
App.FeedbackTooltip: Report a problem or suggest an idea
App.Guidance: Wayfinder handles the picks — ancestry, feats, class branches, spells. Ability boosts and skill increases are walked through here too. Anything Wayfinder can't model cleanly hands off to your character sheet.

Feedback.Title: Wayfinder feedback
Feedback.Heading: Tell me what happened
Feedback.Intro: Two ways to reach me. Pick whichever sounds closer — I'd rather get a rough report than none at all.
Feedback.ExternalTitle: These go to GitHub, and they're public
Feedback.ExternalBody: You'll need a free GitHub account to post, and anyone can read what you write. Opens in a new browser tab.
Feedback.BugHint: Something did the wrong thing, or nothing at all.
Feedback.FeatureHint: Something that would make building easier.
Feedback.Prefill: Your Wayfinder, Foundry, and PF2E versions are filled in for you.
Feedback.Privacy: Screenshots often catch player names and your world's invite link — worth a look before you post.
Feedback.CoverageHint: — a step Wayfinder hands back to the PF2E sheet may simply not be covered yet.
Feedback.Discord: Prefer not to use GitHub? Find me on Discord as

Feedback.Name: Feedback
Feedback.Label: Open feedback

ExtraPacks.Name: Extra PF2E compendium allowlist
ExtraPacks.Hint: Comma-separated compendium ids or wildcards to search in addition to the official PF2E packs. Use my-module.* for every compendium in one module, or * for every installed compendium.

CompendiumSources.Name: Wayfinder content sources
CompendiumSources.Label: Configure compendia
CompendiumSources.Hint: Choose which additional PF2E Item compendia Wayfinder searches and review the character-building content found in each one.

EquipmentPolicy.Name: Starting equipment policy
EquipmentPolicy.Label: Configure equipment policy
EquipmentPolicy.Hint: Choose the official starting-wealth recipes, equipment sources, rarity ceiling, and review authority used by Wayfinder.

SpellRarityCeiling.Name: Player max eligible rarity
SpellRarityCeiling.Hint: Spells up to this rarity appear without a per-step attestation. For higher rarities, players must record character or rules Access, or GM permission reported by the player, unless Unique is selected. This record is not verified GM authorization. Tradition, rank, cantrip, curriculum, and fixed spell restrictions still apply.

EquipmentPolicy.Title: Starting equipment policy
EquipmentPolicy.Heading: Set campaign equipment rules
EquipmentPolicy.Intro: These world rules control eligibility and review. Player sorting and display preferences can never broaden them.
EquipmentPolicy.ActorOwnerChooses: Actor owner chooses an enabled recipe
EquipmentPolicy.PackFamiliesHint: Selecting a package family permits its equipment Item compendia only when PF2E's own pack and publication-source settings also permit them.
EquipmentPolicy.GmOnly: Only a current GM may configure starting equipment policy.
EquipmentPolicy.RecipeRequired: Enable at least one official starting-wealth recipe.

CompendiumSources.Title: Wayfinder content sources
CompendiumSources.Heading: Choose additional compendia
CompendiumSources.Intro: Official PF2E sources are always available. Enable only the additional Item compendia your campaign uses.
CompendiumSources.Guidance: Counts describe raw PF2E item document types. Support modules can reuse ancestry, heritage, or class documents for companions and other automation; Wayfinder filters individual player choices independently. Third-party and prose-based rules can still require GM review or manual setup.
CompendiumSources.GlobalWildcardTitle: Every Item compendium is currently enabled
CompendiumSources.LegacyPatternBody: The existing setting contains: {patterns}. The current matches are checked below. Saving replaces these patterns with the exact packs you approve, so future packs are not enabled automatically.
CompendiumSources.UnmatchedLegacyPatterns: These patterns currently match no available Item compendium. They remain checked below and stay saved until you clear them: {patterns}
CompendiumSources.SearchPlaceholder: Search name, module, or pack id…
CompendiumSources.ScanErrors: Some counts could not be read
CompendiumSources.NoRelevantItems: No recognized builder item types found
CompendiumSources.NoItemPacks: No Item compendia are available in this world.
CompendiumSources.SaveNote: Changing sources never removes items already applied to actors. Open drafts using a disabled source may need review.
CompendiumSources.GmOnly: Only a GM can configure Wayfinder content sources.

Notifications.OwnerOnly: Only the character's owner can use Wayfinder on this sheet.
Notifications.MissingSelections: Finish the remaining steps before applying.
Notifications.NoPendingSteps: There are no Wayfinder-guided steps to apply. Check the PF2E sheet for any native or manual choices.
Notifications.DuplicateSelections: You can't pick the same option twice in one draft.
Notifications.ApplyCancelled: Apply cancelled — your draft is still here.
Notifications.ApplyFailed: Couldn't apply the changes. Your draft is intact — review and try again.
